form_analysis.feedback: Comprehensive aftercare for a multi-modal rejuvenating treatment. Good focus on protecting collagen stimulation and managing micro-trauma from devices (if used). Strong link between aftercare and long-term results.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is designed to support your skin's natural repair and regeneration processes, protect new collagen formation, and maximise the firming, smoothing, and rejuvenating results of your treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this aftercare advice to nurture your skin and extend the benefits of your anti-ageing facial.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin may be flushed, feel warm, tight, and look slightly swollen for 24-48 hours. If microcurrent or radiofrequency was used, you may experience a mild, sunburn-like sensation. Mild peeling or dryness may occur 2-4 days post-treatment as part of the cellular turnover process.

sections.title: Supporting Collagen Production
items: Keep the skin well-hydrated. Use a peptide-rich, reparative moisturizer to support healing and collagen synthesis.
Drink plenty of water and consume foods rich in antioxidants (berries, leafy greens) and Vitamin C.
Ensure adequate sleep, as collagen repair is most active at night.

sections.title: Product Use and Restrictions
items: Avoid all exfoliating agents (retinol, retinoids, glycolic acid, salicylic acid, scrubs) for 5-7 days to allow the skin barrier to recover fully.
You may resume using growth factors, peptides, and gentle antioxidants (like Vitamin C serums) after 3 days, unless otherwise instructed.
If LED light therapy was part of your facial, no specific restrictions apply beyond gentle care.

sections.title: Sun and Environmental Protection
sections.content: Sun exposure is the primary driver of skin ageing. To protect your investment and new collagen, you MUST apply a high-SPF (30-50+) broad-spectrum sunscreen daily. Avoid direct sun exposure for 48 hours post-treatment.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
items: Avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, steam rooms, and hot baths for 48 hours to minimise inflammation and facial flushing.
Avoid facial massages or aggressive manipulation of the skin for 1 week.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: It is advisable to avoid makeup for 24 hours. If necessary, use mineral-based makeup applied gently with clean tools.

sections.title: Swelling and Redness Management
sections.content: Sleep with your head slightly elevated on an extra pillow for the first night or two to reduce morning swelling. A cool compress can be applied to soothe redness.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: Immediate plumping and glow are often visible. The true collagen-building results develop over 4-6 weeks post-treatment.
A course of treatments is typically recommended for cumulative, long-term anti-ageing benefits.
Contact your therapist if you experience severe or persistent redness, pain, blistering, or signs of infection.
